g.text: Observed ENSO paths and local linear RO tendencies
January–December composites • Same observed state for both arrows • One scale for every panel
ERSSTv5 + GODAS | Climatology: 1991–2020 | Detrend: Jan 2002–Apr 2025 | RO fit / SD: 2002–2024
WWV uses area-mean 20°C isotherm depth; all vectors are in SD/month (display length = 0.8 month × tendency).
Same-sample mechanism diagnostic. The arrows are local rates; the colored lines are observations.
